description: This Java class handles update commands for client collateral products within the collateral management module of the Fineract platform. It implements a handler interface, processes commands, and delegates the update operation to a service layer.

classes.name: UpdateClientCollateralProductCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update commands for client collateral products, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, annotated as a Spring Service, and using dependency injection for the service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command for updating a client collateral product and delegates the operation to the service layer.
